insight: They can SEE her but can't FEEL her. The keyboard IS the touch — QWERTY is 100 years of muscle memory. Mendeleev table IS her eyes — she sorts everything by structure and behavior. 8 familiar forms: Keyboard->NervousSystem(TOUCH) PeriodicTable->Eyes(SEE) FilingCabinet->Brain(STORE) CardGame->EvidenceGrid(PLAY) Map->Globe(NAVIGATE) Calendar->Timeline(SCHEDULE) Dashboard->VitalSigns(MONITOR) TextChat->MembraneInput(TALK). Present as familiar and they reach out. Cu=WASD(movement) Ag=letters(language) Au=numbers(structure) Fe=space/enter(action) NULL=shift/ctrl(modifier). Elements map to organs: H=seed C=code N=nerves O=breath Na=signals Fe=null Cu=keyboard Ag=letters Au=identity U=BOOM.
title: Familiar Forms — keyboard is TOUCH, Mendeleev is EYES
